title: 11 嘉世越云，论坛体
slug: 全职高手首先你不会被一见钟情
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

-荣耀论坛-职业专区

主题贴：给我穿越风雨的力量，你的微笑是我的信仰。【孙翔微博截图】

0L：真给我搞疑惑了，何意味呢我请问？

1L：爸呀大哥？文盲能不能闭嘴？

2L：啊啊啊啊啊他是不是不想活了！

3L：信仰哥！

4L：给我笑成一坨了，你游攻坚手就这么性情。

5L：外面已经骂得火山爆发了，来这楼里躲一下。

6L：不关注你游的舍友看了都说妈呀。

7L：大半夜刷到的微博，我直接垂死病中惊坐起一声我草把全寝室都喊起来了……

8L：你游最精彩的一天。不对，不止你游，这事已经破圈了，全部人都在吃瓜看戏，你敢信在脱粉回踩刷到了孙翔？我笑得好难受。

9L：羊姐至暗时刻。

10L：往好处想，这条秒发秒删说明孩子心里还是有点数的，但是被截图下来了那就属实运气不好。

11L：我不行了……老师我家孩子没有坏心思，他就是打输了心里委屈，想炫耀一下还有人跟他站在一边，绝对不是谈恋爱啊，嘉世都发通告了说是妹妹，老师们明鉴啊。

12L：嘉世公关反应最快的一次，这边上热搜那边立马辟谣说是妹妹，只看出来陶轩确实急了。

13L：这是羊姐吗？之前在越云不是满嘴獠牙大恶霸吗，平等霸凌五个队友，几天没见水平这么拉了？

14L：孙翔他到底是怎么想的呢，费解。

15L：差不多得了，擂台赛一穿三还要怎样，一天天的节奏这么大闹麻了。

16L：孙翔还能有孝子？难绷。

17L：一穿三然后团战我脱节是吧。

18L：一穿三很难吗，越云新人第一场也是一穿三啊，团队赛全程压着对面打，大比分拿下首胜，人家说什么了？

19L：颤抖吧孩子们，叶杂的大卡车已经开到嘉世楼下了，大花圈大立牌也都在路上了。

20L：爸呀大哥……叶杂就这么八倍速。

21L：其实早就想扇陶轩了。

22L：秋狗都退役了，叶杂还搞这套除了招笑何意味？

23L：被你叶爹按着扇了三个赛季的霸图狗也敢出来叫了？你叶爹是退役了不是拉了。

Page (1/3)

-Glory Forum-Career Zone

Topic post: Give me the strength to go through the wind and rain, your smile is my faith.[Screenshot of Sun Xiang’s Weibo]

0L: I’m really confused. What does it mean? May I ask?

1L: Dad, brother?Can the illiterate please shut up?

2L: Ahhhhhhhh he doesn’t want to live anymore!

3L: Brother Faith!

4L: You made me laugh so hard, you have such a bad temper.

5L: There has been a volcano erupting outside. Come and take shelter in this building.

6L: Roommates who don’t follow your travels all said “Oh my god” when they saw it.

7L: When I read this Weibo post in the middle of the night, I sat up in a fit of death and screamed out loud in the whole dormitory...

8L: Best day of your trip.No, it’s not just you. This thing has broken the circle. Everyone is watching the show. Do you dare to believe that you can get Sun Xiang by stepping back after losing fans?I laughed so hard.

9L: Sister Yang’s darkest moment.

10L: Thinking on the bright side, the fact that this post was posted and deleted immediately shows that the child still has some ideas, but if it is screenshotted, it is really bad luck.

11L: I can't do it anymore... Teacher, my child has no bad intentions. He just feels aggrieved after losing and wants to show off that there is someone on his side. This is definitely not a relationship. Excellent Era has even issued a notice saying that he is his younger sister. Teachers are aware of this.

12L: Excellent Era’s public relations response was the fastest. Here, there were hot searches and there, they immediately refuted the rumors and said it was the younger sister. It was obvious that Tao Xuan was really anxious.

13L: Is this Sister Sheep?Wasn't he a big fanged bully in Yueyun before? He bullied five teammates equally. I haven't seen him this good in a few days?

14L: What exactly does Sun Xiang think? It’s hard to understand.

15L: That’s pretty much it. What’s the point of wearing one and three in the arena? The day-to-day rhythm is so messy.

16L: Can Sun Xiang still have a filial son?Difficult to stretch.

17L: One wears three and then I get out of touch in team battles, right?

18L: Is it difficult to go through three in one? It was also the first time for Yueyun newcomers to go through three in one. They dominated the opponent throughout the team competition and won their first victory with a big score. What did people say?

19L: Shake it up, kids, Ye Za’s big truck has already arrived at the Excellent Era building, and the big wreaths and signboards are also on the way.

20L: Dad, brother...Ye Za is just eight times faster.

21L: Actually, I have wanted to slap Tao Xuan for a long time.

22L: Qiu Gou has retired, what’s the point of Ye Za still doing this thing besides making fun of him?

23L: The Tyranny dog ​​that your father Ye has been holding down and slapping for three seasons dares to come out and bark?Your father, Ye, has retired, not retired.
